worker_notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text identifies itself as a Final Report, names Cutright et al (2011), and describes the Experiment 5 national/international T-shirt replication and its results. Its Source URL https://osf.io/download/fzut6/ matches the supplied replication file URL identifier. It is a primary replication final report, not merely an abstract or preregistration. The text contains no replication author list, title matching the full supplied project label, or date; those bibliographic elements cannot be independently verified from this allowed source. The supplied project label includes eg3p whereas this report explicitly identifies Experiment 5; this label discrepancy is retained, not used to select another test. The supplied original locator does not assign a replication study number. The report identifies a single SCORE focal hypothesis and its three-way interaction, establishing target correspondence by content rather than row order or numeric matching. Only es_value_r was assigned. B = -.069 is retained as printed; the source supplies no named ser_method metric or standardisation identity, and no metric conversion was performed. The same-test p = .818 and Wald = .053 are printed in the evidence; p and n fields are unassigned placeholders. Original and reported_success are also unassigned placeholders. No PDF was supplied.
